title: RFdiffusion All-Atom and LigandMPNN design enantioselective photoenzymes
summary: RFdiffusion-AA and LigandMPNN generated de novo photoenzymes positioning a benzophenone unnatural amino acid next to a quinolone substrate. The designs catalyzed [2+2] cycloadditions with 99% e.e. and 9:1 regioselectivity, and a substrate-bound X-ray structure matched the design model. Scaffolding mirror image catalytic sites gave enantiocomplementary photoenzymes (98% e.e., more than 20:1 r.r.). Preprint.
ai_technology: RFdiffusion All-Atom and LigandMPNN deep learning protein design
organization: University of Washington; University of Manchester
